comment: Pinned downloads for tools/fetch-models.ps1. Every file is verified by SHA-256 before it is moved into place. Destinations are relative to windows/.

whisperServer.runtimeRequirement: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime (MSVCP140, VCRUNTIME140, VCRUNTIME140_1, VCOMP140)

models.name: ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights, ggml conversion by the whisper.cpp authors)

models.name: ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin
models.purpose: Server-side VAD (--vad --vad-model), used only when no word times are needed.
models.license: MIT (Silero VAD by the Silero Team, ggml conversion by ggml-org)

models.name: ggml-tiny.bin
models.purpose: Small multilingual model for the gated LocalWhisperLiveTests only (fetch-models.ps1 -TestModel).
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights, ggml conversion by the whisper.cpp authors)

diarization.purpose: Offline acoustic speaker diarization (Wallfly.Diarization, sherpa-onnx). Fetched by default or alone with fetch-models.ps1 -Diarization. Wallfly.Diarization.ModelLocator pins the same sizes and SHA-256.
diarization.runtime: NuGet org.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx 2.0.1 + org.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.runtime.win-x64 2.0.1 (Apache-2.0; onnxruntime MIT), referenced by Wallfly.Diarization.csproj, not fetched here.

files.name: sherpa-onnx-pyannote-segmentation-3-0
files.purpose: Speaker segmentation: pyannote segmentation-3.0 as ONNX.
files.license: MIT (pyannote/segmentation-3.0, Copyright (c) 2022 CNRS; ONNX export by k2-fsa)

files.name: 3dspeaker_speech_eres2net_sv_en_voxceleb_16k.onnx
files.purpose: Speaker embeddings: 3D-Speaker ERes2Net trained on VoxCeleb. Chosen over WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM (same speed, better separation of synthetic voices at threshold 0.6).
files.repository: github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx, release speaker-recongition-models (hash also in its checksum.txt); original modelscope.cn/models/iic/speech_eres2net_sv_en_voxceleb_16k
